caption: The video depicts a woman with long dark curly hair, in a pink cropped sweatshirt and white sweatpants, standing in profile facing an ornate white-framed mirror in a softly lit bedroom. She begins holding both hands bent up at her neck, only shifting her head slightly. A brief blurred motion of one arm passes near her midsection before her hands leave the neck. She then raises both hands to the top of her head, gathering her hair upward toward the crown. She keeps both hands raised, manipulating her hair at the crown. The cropped sweatshirt rides up to reveal a dark band at her midriff. The framing drifts subtly, the mirror and subject shifting a few pixels.
